name: Joshua
summary: Moses' helper, who became Israel's leader after him. He led the people across the Jordan and into the land of Canaan.

key_moments.title: A Good Report
key_moments.description: Joshua and Caleb, who had searched out Canaan, tore their clothes and told the people the land was very good. They urged them not to fear, but the people wanted to stone them.

key_moments.title: Crossing the Jordan
key_moments.description: The LORD promised to be with Joshua as He had been with Moses. When the priests carrying the ark stepped into the Jordan, the water stopped, and all Israel crossed on dry ground.

key_moments.title: The Walls of Jericho
key_moments.description: The LORD told Joshua He had given him Jericho. On the seventh day the people marched around the city seven times, and when they shouted, the wall collapsed.

key_moments.title: The Sun Stands Still
key_moments.description: As Israel fought the Amorites, Joshua spoke to the LORD and told the sun to stand still over Gibeon. The sun stayed in the sky for nearly a full day, because the LORD was fighting for Israel.

key_moments.title: Choose Whom You Will Serve
key_moments.description: At Shechem, Joshua gathered the tribes and told them to fear the LORD and turn from the gods their fathers had served. He told them to choose whom they would serve, but he and his house would serve the LORD.
